summary: B12X runs MXFP8 MoE experts natively (W8A8)
compatibility: No user action required. vLLM uses it only when moe_backend b12x is requested for MXFP8 experts (vllm-957).
details: MXFP8 expert weights (E4M3 values with one UE8M0 scale per 32 values) are prepared byte-exact and run on the block-scaled MXFP8 tensor cores, for intermediate sizes divisible by 32, such as the 320-wide per-rank MTP draft experts of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next QAD step 5500 checkpoint at TP2.
W6A8 (MXFP6) expert scale grids are checked by the same rule at load: a NaN (0xFF) scale byte or a non-contiguous grid is rejected instead of copied.
